name: stats
description: Model usage statistics: tokens, cost, cache use and generation speed. Based on Elowen's shared usage records, they keep task tracking separate from operating costs.

strings.title: Statistics
strings.workspaceIntro: An overview of tokens, cost, cache use and the speed of each model.
strings.tokensByModelHint: Share of all recorded tokens in the selected range.
strings.costByModelHint: Share of tracked spend; models without cost data are excluded.
strings.trendHint: Daily tokens and tracked cost from the shared usage ledger, up to 90 days.
strings.trendUnavailable: The daily trend is available only for the latest 90 days.
strings.emptyDescription: Model consumption in the selected range will appear here.
strings.noChartData: No data is available for this chart.
strings.resetBody: This permanently clears your recorded chat usage and the usage-origin records behind the breakdown. Conversations and agent session transcripts remain available.
strings.resetFailed: Usage statistics could not be reset.
strings.originTrackedSince: Tracked since {day}. Consumption before that date has no recorded origin.
strings.originTrackedNever: No consumption with a recorded origin yet.
strings.originUntrustedWarning: {count} entries come from a header that cannot be verified.
strings.originUntrustedHelp: An address can be verified only if the request passed through the configured reverse proxy. Otherwise, the client provides it. If Elowen does not run behind such a proxy, turn off Trusted proxy in environment settings.
strings.originEmptyBody: Usage with a recorded origin will appear here once there are replies in this period.
strings.originFootnote: Tokens and cost are ranked separately. An IP address identifies a connection, not a specific person.
